attributes.board_name: Virginia Board of Audiology and Speech-Language Pathology (Department of Health Professions)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Activities, programs or courses related to audiology or speech-language pathology (according to the license held), offered or approved by a board-recognized, accredited sponsor or organization. Up to 1 hour per year for volunteer services to low-income patients through a local health department or free clinic (1 CE hour per 3 hours of service).
rules.new_licensee_rule: Exempt from CE for the first renewal after initial licensure in Virginia (18VAC30-21-100 D).
rules.audit_note: The board may periodically audit; audited licensees must send all supporting documentation within 30 days. Keep CE documentation 3 years after renewal (title, sponsor, date, hours).
rules.notes: Annual renewal by June 30; at least 10 hours each year before the renewal date. Dual audiology + SLP licensees: 15 hours total for both licenses, with at least 7.5 contact hours in each profession. The rule applies to every active license the board issues, including the school speech-language pathology license (renewal fee $40). One-year extension possible for good cause on written request before the renewal date. Inactive licensees have no CE. Virginia does not license SLP assistants (they work as unlicensed assistants under 18VAC30-21-140).
